title: Fireworks
description: Click the night and it blooms: rockets, bursts and falling sparks on one canvas.
usage: The sky fires on its own every second or so, and any click launches a rocket at that point. Colors come from the tokens, so the show matches the site throwing it. For launches and milestones — and for the one page a year that gets to be a festival.
a11y: A light show, labeled as one: the canvas is aria-hidden behind the words that carry the news. Under prefers-reduced-motion the sky stays dark and quiet, and the announcement does the celebrating.
